applicability: Family context composed for an invariant-identity or exact-invariant-revision selection within one bound review comparison.
conditions: The existing invariant read policy discovers only the union of directly related family identities on the two bound snapshots; completed sibling rosters do not discover further families.

Each discovered identity is resolved on both bound snapshots through the existing family owner, using the family’s full authored revision population and existing predecessor-based head rule rather than the membership-bearing subset.

A unique authored head supplies its own guarantee and exact roster. Competing legitimate heads, including memberless heads, remain explicit unresolved candidates; genuinely absent or unreadable family sides keep their distinct states.

Primary invariant revision, statement, conditions and evidence remain independently composed, and family rosters use the existing comparison/subject-bound continuation and complete source-inventory owners.
exclusions: No inferred membership, inherited roster, arbitrary latest head, extra family traversal, current-store substitution or fabricated historical counterpart.
Explicit family-revision requests retain their existing exact-revision selection and recorded-history contract; this does not replace them with a head lookup.
This obligation does not certify historical assessment loading, all evidence channels, installed browser behavior or whole-product acceptance.
statement: Each discovered family is composed independently on both bound snapshots through the existing family owner and authored-head rule. Missing membership of the selected invariant neither erases an existing family counterpart nor pins the family to a historical predecessor that still cites the member.
